summary: Backend-only regression for the Swiss Ephemeris Human Design service. All 13 API contract tests plus the pyswisseph engine regression suite pass. Verified: health, city catalog (default list, Bandung search returning id=1650357/Asia/Jakarta, London/UK, id lookup, 404), and /api/blueprint happy path (Yosep = Generator / Sacral / 1/3, Strategy 'Wait to Respond', 13 personality + 13 design activations with valid gate/line ranges) and all four validation errors (ISO date, impossible date 31-02-1990, empty name, invalid city_id) returning 400. Regression script prints 'All regression tests passed.' with all 5 charts computing valid Type/Authority/Profile.
action_items: Optional cleanup: /app/backend/tests/test_blueprint_contract.py is a stale iteration-2 file using a hardcoded city_id='jakarta' and reads EXPO_BACKEND_URL (which is not set). It is superseded by test_backend_api.py and would fail if collected via a broader pytest run. Consider removing or updating it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly delegates the calculation to human_design.calculate_human_design and preserves MongoDB compatibility without persisting blueprints (no _id leakage). All endpoints validate input and return meaningful 400/404.
Strict DD-MM-YYYY validation via datetime.strptime is correctly rejecting ISO and impossible dates.
